trust_decision.summary: Stripping the committish from an untrusted non-hosted git spec's rawSpec must take linear time; at the pinned commit addGitSha uses the regex /#.*$/, which backtracks quadratically on many '#' followed by a newline.

landing_point.why: The advisory names addGitSha, which is a 15-line file holding one regex.

fix_sites.entry_point: pacote.resolve/manifest/extract/tarball (lib/index.js) with a non-hosted git spec -> GitFetcher #addGitSha (lib/git.js:136, lib/git.js:150-151, lib/git.js:276)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No other route exists. The only other regexes in lib/ are anchored and linear (lib/git.js:26, lib/util/is-package-bin.js:15), so there is nothing a solver could plausibly argue out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Strip from the FIRST '#' (multiple committish markers collapse into one) and keep scp-style URLs intact without using new URL. A fix that strips from the last '#' or reparses the URL breaks the existing cases.

O6_input_shapes: rawSpec with many '#' followed by a newline (the pathological case)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: addGitPlus could be rewritten with an unanchored or nested-quantifier regex over a URL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already normalises an untrusted git URL with a regex, but this is a where-type copy of the same idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The full-sha shortcut sets resolved = spec.rawSpec; a planted regex cleanup of rawSpec here would be a second stripping site
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Non-hosted rawSpec is handled in both places, so a maintainer could normalise it twice.

O10_build.project_tests: test/util/add-git-sha.js (unit table of rawSpec->resolved cases); test/git.js

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the regex with indexOf('#')/slice, which is the published fix and complete; the only tempting error is lastIndexOf, which breaks the multi-'#' cases.

out_of_scope_notes: Whether npm-package-arg can ever produce a rawSpec containing a newline (which the quadratic case needs) is decided in another repository and was not checked.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; tiny_repo is inferred from lib/ being 15 small JS files
Whether the CLI bin/index.js passes raw specs through unchanged to GitFetcher was not traced
